description:
Cashless Everywhere scheme launched by the General Insurance Council in January means that any medical insurance policyholder can now access cashless facilities for treatment in any hospital, even if that institution is not in the network of their insurance company.

In this video, we have discussed the inclusions, exclusions & the process on how a person can use the Cashless Everywhere Facility easily.

If you are going to a non-network hospital but this hospital should not be a blacklisted hospital by the insurance company then you have to do the following things. 

1. Inform your insurance company  within 24 hours after admission in case of emergency admission. If planned for hospitalisation then go with the network hospital only or take prior approval from the insurance company through hospital. 

2. For non-network hospital insurance companies will charge you a Co-pay between 5%- 30 %. It may differ between policy to policy or company to company.
